metadata.notes: EU-origin national food-composition databases (EuroFIR FoodEXplorer and national FDCs) were not bundled because their redistribution licenses do not permit checked-in exports. The catalog therefore ships USDA FoodData Central rows (public domain) with per-row provenance; EU-oriented foods are included where USDA coverage exists and are labeled with their USDA source. No nutrient rows from different sources are merged under one ID.
